title: Events
subtitle: Your household's safety timeline
historyLimit: Showing up to the 100 most recent events.

empty.title: No events yet
empty.body: Detections and camera status changes will appear here. Check that your camera is online.
empty.filteredBody: Try viewing all events to see the rest of your timeline.

detail.checkHint: An automatic detection needs a human check. Review the situation before marking it as a false alarm.

snapshot.alt: Camera snapshot captured for this event
snapshot.missing: No snapshot is available for this event.
snapshot.expired: The private snapshot could not be loaded. Refresh its access link to try again.
snapshot.private: Private snapshot · accessible to your household

alert.check: Please check on your loved one. If urgent help is needed, call emergency services.
alert.callHint: Opens the phone dialer. Halo does not place a call automatically.

action.title: Respond to this event
action.falseAlarmHint: Use this after checking that no help is needed. The event stays in your timeline.
action.closed: This event has already been reviewed.
action.demo: Example event. Responses are disabled until a real household is connected.
action.invalid: Check the event and response, then try again.
action.unavailable: Responses cannot be saved in demo mode.
action.householdRequired: Join a household before responding to events.
action.changed: This event was updated or is no longer available. Refresh the page to see its current status.
action.failed: Your response was not saved. Please try again.

error.title: Events could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

missing.title: Event not found
missing.body: It may have been removed or may belong to another household.
